{{Quote|General, the Republic command—the entire Hosnian system—it's all-gone.|Taslin Brance, to General Leia Organa|<ref name="FAnovel">[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' novelization]]</ref>}}
'''Taslin Brance''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Resistance officer|officer]] who held the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[major]] in the [[Resistance]] during its [[Cold War|conflict]] with the [[First Order]].

==Biography==
Taslin Brance was a [[human]] [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[planet]] [[Rinn]].<ref name="ECUC" /> Brance eventually became a [[major]] in the [[Resistance Army|ground forces]] of the [[Resistance]],<ref name="TFA VD" /> serving in the [[Resistance base]] on [[D'Qar]] about 30 [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]], along with [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and others in the Resistance leadership.<ref name="FAnovel" />

Brance was the first to receive a coded and encrypted transmission informing the Resistance of an [[Attack on Tuanul|attack]] by [[First Order]] [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] against a [[Jakku]] [[Tuanul|community]], resulting in the [[death]] of [[Lor San Tekka]]. The report also noted the destruction of [[Resistance pilot|pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]]'s [[T-70 X-wing starfighter|X-wing fighter]], leading Brance to openly speculate that Dameron and his [[astromech droid]], [[BB-8]], had perished. Organa admonished him for speculation, who noted BB-8's resourcefulness and expressed hope for his survival.<ref name="FAnovel" />

Brance was also present at the D'Qar base when the Resistance received word that [[Hosnian Prime]], the planet serving as the headquarters for the [[New Republic Senate|Galactic Senate]], had been [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destroyed]] by the First Order's [[Starkiller Base]] [[superweapon]]. Shocked and horrified by the news, Brance was the first to report the planet's destruction to Organa and the other Resistance leaders.<ref name="FAnovel" /> Sometime following the [[Battle of Starkiller Base]], Dameron sent Brance his compiled flight logs that he collected in one case file, doing so upon Brance's request.<ref name="Flight Log">''[[Poe Dameron: Flight Log]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Taslin Brance was portrayed by [[Emun Elliott]] in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] ([[2015]]). Best known for his roles in the television series ''Game of Thrones ''and the science fiction film [[Wikipedia:Prometheus (2012 film)|''Prometheus'']] ([[2012]]), Elliott had only one line in the film: "A laser cannon?"<ref name="GamesRadar">{{WebCite|url=https://www.gamesradar.com/well-known-actors-bit-parts-star-wars-force-awakens|text=8 well-known actors you probably missed in Star Wars: The Force Awakens|author=Fletcher, Rosie|work=[[Wikipedia:GamesRadar+|GamesRadar+]]|archivedate=20210225094139}}</ref>

Although his rank badge clearly identifies him as a major,<ref name="TFA VD" /> Brance was both referred to and addressed as a lieutenant in [[Alan Dean Foster]]'s [[Star Wars: The Force Awakens (novelization)|novelization]] of ''The Force Awakens''.<ref name="FAnovel" />

Brance's first name "Taslin" was not revealed until the release of the [[2016]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="ECUC" />
